<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000762" name="us-gaap:DebtPolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_846_eus-gaap--DebtPolicyTextBlock_zWzwdxhTlOE7" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><span id="xdx_86C_zvJlrAoTaVT9">Convertible
notes and notes payable</span></b> &#8211; The Company accounts for convertible promissory notes in accordance with ASC Topic 470-20, <i>Debt
with Conversion and Other Options </i>(&#8220;ASC 470-20&#8221;) and has not elected the fair value option as provided for within ASC
Topics 815 and 825. Accordingly, the Company evaluated the embedded conversion and other features within convertible notes and notes
payable to determine whether any of the embedded features should be bifurcated from the host instrument and accounted for as a derivative
at fair value. Based on management&#8217;s evaluation, the Company determined that none of the embedded features were required to be
bifurcated and accounted for separately.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000764" name="us-gaap:DerivativesPolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_842_eus-gaap--DerivativesPolicyTextBlock_zayfzAEuzgBe" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><span id="xdx_86C_zEEu90uKhvIb">Warrant
liabilities</span></b> &#8211; The Company accounts for ordinary share or ADS warrants as either equity instruments, liabilities or derivative
liabilities in accordance with ASC Topic 480, <i>Distinguishing Liabilities from Equity</i> (&#8220;ASC 480&#8221;) and/or ASC Topic
815, <i>Derivatives and Hedging</i> (&#8220;ASC 815&#8221;), depending on the specific terms of the warrant agreement. Liability-classified
warrants are recorded at their estimated fair values at issuance and are remeasured each reporting period until they are exercised, terminated,
reclassified or otherwise settled. Changes in the estimated fair value of liability-classified warrants are recorded in &#8220;change
in fair value of warrant liabilities&#8221; in the Company&#8217;s consolidated statements of operations and comprehensive loss. Equity-classified
warrants are recorded within &#8220;additional paid-in capital&#8221; in the Company&#8217;s consolidated statements of shareholders&#8217;
equity (deficit) at the time of issuance and are not subject to remeasurement.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
connection with the sale of the ADSs in the September 2022 Registered Direct Offering, the Company issued to the investors registered
Series A warrants (&#8220;Series A Warrants&#8221;) to purchase an aggregate of <span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues_pid_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeriesAWarrantsMember_znxTtvefling" title="Purchase of aggregate shares"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_SeriesAWarrantsMember" id="Fact000766" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">755,000</ix:nonFraction></span> ADSs at $<span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--SharesIssuedPricePerShare_iI_pid_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeriesAWarrantsMember_zc88Iw5TucUi" title="Shares issued price per share"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:SharesIssuedPricePerShare" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_SeriesAWarrantsMember" id="Fact000768" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">17.00</ix:nonFraction></span> per ADS and registered Series
B warrants (&#8220;Series B Warrants&#8221;) to purchase an aggregate of <span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues_pid_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeriesBWarrantsMember_z4LWgjJYwOIg" title="Purchase of aggregate shares"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_SeriesBWarrantsMember" id="Fact000770" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">755,000</ix:nonFraction></span> ADSs at $<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--SharesIssuedPricePerShare_iI_pid_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeriesBWarrantsMember_znBli0Sbs35" title="Shares issued price per share"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:SharesIssuedPricePerShare" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_SeriesBWarrantsMember" id="Fact000772" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">17.00</ix:nonFraction></span> per ADS (collectively, the &#8220;September
2022 Warrants&#8221;).The Company determined that the September 2022 Warrants are not indexed to the Company&#8217;s own stock in the
manner contemplated by ASC 815-40-15, <i>Determining Whether an Instrument (or Embedded Feature) Is Indexed to an Entity&#8217;s Own

In September 2024, all outstanding Series A Warrants expired unexercised.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000782" name="us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpensePolicy"><p id="xdx_847_eus-gaap--ResearchAndDevelopmentExpensePolicy_ze8g6r4tuHif" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><span id="xdx_86B_zC0Sm2kB8n9g">Research
and development expenses</span> &#8211;</b> Costs associated with research and development are expensed as incurred unless there is an alternative
future use in other research and development projects. Research and development expenses include, among other costs, salaries and personnel&#8211;related
expenses, fees paid for contract research services, fees paid to clinical research organizations, costs incurred by outside laboratories,
manufacturers and other accredited facilities in connection with clinical trials and preclinical studies.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Payments
made prior to the receipt of goods or services to be used in research and development are capitalized until the goods or services are
received. The Company records expenses related to clinical studies and manufacturing development activities based on its estimates of
the services received and efforts expended pursuant to contracts with multiple contract research organizations and manufacturing vendors
that conduct and manage these activities on its behalf. The financial terms of these agreements are subject to negotiation, vary from
contract to contract, and may result in uneven cash flows. There may be instances in which payments made to the Company&#8217;s vendors
will exceed the level of services provided and result in a prepayment of the expense. Payments under some of these contracts depend on
factors such as the successful enrollment of subjects and the completion of clinical study milestones. In amortizing or accruing service
fees, the Company estimates the time period over which services will be performed, enrollment of subjects, number of sites activated
and the level of effort to be expended in each period. If the actual timing of the performance of services or the level of effort varies
from the Company&#8217;s estimate, the Company will adjust the accrued or prepaid expense balance accordingly.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company accounts for research and development tax credits at the time its realization becomes probable as a credit to research and development
expenses in the consolidated statements of operations and comprehensive loss.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000784" name="AKTX:MergerRelatedExpensesPolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_844_ecustom--MergerRelatedExpensesPolicyTextBlock_zRZCdOsaGR4h" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><span id="xdx_86D_z8tNlmENYFh6">Merger-related
expenses</span> &#8211;</b> Merger-related expenses include direct expenses incurred in connection with the acquisition of Peak Bio and are
comprised primarily of legal and professional fees and other incremental costs directly associated to the acquisition.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000786" name="AKTX:RestructuringAndOtherExpensesPolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_849_ecustom--RestructuringAndOtherExpensesPolicyTextBlock_zhAarhKWXia2" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><span id="xdx_860_z06L7QlLrIo6">Restructuring
and other expenses</span> &#8211;</b> In May 2024, the Company implemented a reduction-in-force of approximately <span id="xdx_901_ecustom--RestructuringAndRelatedCostExpectedNumberOfPositionsEliminatedPeriodPercent_pid_dp_uPure_c20250501__20250531_zPHa6DEDljn9" title="Restructuring and related cost"><ix:nonFraction name="AKTX:RestructuringAndRelatedCostExpectedNumberOfPositionsEliminatedPeriodPercent" contextRef="From2025-05-012025-05-31" id="Fact000788" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">67</ix:nonFraction></span>% of its total workforce
as a result of the recently announced program prioritization under which the Company&#8217;s nomacopan HSCT-TMA program was suspended.
The reduction-in-force was part of an operational restructuring plan (the &#8220;May 2024 Plan&#8221;) which included the elimination
of certain senior management positions and was completed in the third quarter of 2024. The purpose of the restructuring plan, including
the reduction-in-force, was to reduce HSCT-TMA related operating costs, while supporting the execution of the Company&#8217;s long-term
strategic plan. As of December 31, 2025, the Company does not expect to incur additional restructuring-related expenses related to the
May 2024 Plan.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><p id="xdx_8AA_zOAmaS0Ktxze" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000826" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationOptionAndIncentivePlansPolicy"><p id="xdx_845_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationOptionAndIncentivePlansPolicy_zigXgePLz08g" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><span id="xdx_862_zh5meJ7s2NDf">Stock-based
compensation expense</span> &#8211;</b> The Company measures all stock-based awards granted to employees, directors and non-employees based
on the estimated fair value on the date of grant and recognizes compensation expense of those awards over the requisite service period,
which is generally the vesting period of the respective awards. Forfeitures are accounted for as they occur. The Company classifies stock-based
compensation expense in its consolidated statements of operations and comprehensive loss in the same manner in which the award recipient&#8217;s
payroll costs are classified or in which the award recipient&#8217;s service payments are classified.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
fair value of each restricted ordinary share award is determined on the date of grant based on the fair value of the Company&#8217;s
ordinary shares on that same date. The fair value of each share option grant is determined on the date of grant using the Black-Scholes
option pricing model, which requires inputs based on certain assumptions, including the expected stock price volatility, the expected
term of the award, the risk-free interest rate, and expected dividends (See Note 8). The Company estimates its expected stock price volatility
based on the historical volatility of its ADSs, considering the expected term of the options. The expected term of the Company&#8217;s
options has been determined utilizing the &#8220;simplified&#8221; method for awards that qualify as &#8220;plain-vanilla&#8221; options.
The risk-free interest rate is determined by reference to the U.S. Treasury yield curve in effect at the time of grant of the award for
time periods approximately equal to the expected term of the award. The expected dividend yield is based on the fact that the Company
has never paid cash dividends on ordinary shares and does not expect to pay any cash dividends in the foreseeable future.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000828" name="us-gaap:LesseeLeasesPolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_849_eus-gaap--LesseeLeasesPolicyTextBlock_zbHxxJ8Q5SZ6" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><span id="xdx_865_zJoyVIwIKSQ9">Leases</span>
&#8211;</b> The Company accounts for its leases in accordance with ASC 842, <i>Leases</i>. In accordance with ASC 842, the Company records
a right-of-use (&#8220;ROU&#8221;) asset and corresponding lease liability on the balance sheet for all leases with terms longer than
12 months. Leases with an initial term of twelve months or less are not recorded on the consolidated balance sheet and are recognized
on a straight-line basis over the lease term. As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, the Company did not have any leases with a term longer
than twelve months. Accordingly, no ROU assets and corresponding lease liabilities are included in the Company&#8217;s consolidated balance
sheets as of December 31, 2025 or 2024.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000830" name="us-gaap:IncomeTaxPolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_84B_eus-gaap--IncomeTaxPolicyTextBlock_zxnRGfxwkPnf" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><span id="xdx_863_zDG1gGFAXyHi">Income
taxes</span></b> &#8211; The Company accounts for income taxes in accordance with the accounting rules that require an asset and liability approach
to accounting for income taxes based upon the future expected values of the related assets and liabilities. Deferred income tax assets
and liabilities are determined based on the differences between the financial reporting and tax bases of assets and liabilities and for
tax loss and credit carry forwards and are measured using the expected tax rates estimated to be in effect when such basis differences
reverse. A valuation allowance against deferred tax assets is recorded if, based on the weight of available evidence, it is more likely
than not that some or all of the deferred tax assets will not be realized.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company follows the provisions of ASC 740 &#8220;<i>Accounting for Uncertainty in Income Taxes</i>&#8221; (&#8220;ASC 740&#8221;), which
prescribes recognition thresholds that must be met before a tax position is recognized in the financial statements and provides guidance
on de-recognition, classification, interest and penalties, accounting in interim periods, disclosure, and transition. Under ASC 740,
an entity may only recognize or continue to recognize tax positions that meet a &#8220;more-likely-than-not&#8221; threshold. Interest
and penalties related to uncertain tax positions are recognized as general and administrative expense. At December 31, 2025 and 2024,
the Company had no uncertain tax positions.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000832" name="us-gaap:ComprehensiveIncomePolicyPolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_84F_eus-gaap--ComprehensiveIncomePolicyPolicyTextBlock_z2vqr8VDf2F9" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><span id="xdx_866_zAak8AT0jrY7">Comprehensive
income (loss)</span></b> - Comprehensive loss is defined as the change in equity of a business enterprise during a period from transactions
and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources. The Company&#8217;s other comprehensive loss is comprised of foreign currency
translation adjustments.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000834" name="us-gaap:EarningsPerSharePolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_848_eus-gaap--EarningsPerSharePolicyTextBlock_zciRbVflC935" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><span id="xdx_861_zXYK2x4W6Ccd">Net
loss per share</span> </b>&#8211; Basic net income (loss) per ordinary share is computed by dividing net income (loss) available to ordinary
shareholders by the weighted average number of ordinary shares outstanding during the period, which includes ordinary shares underlying
pre-funded warrants, as such warrant is exercisable, in whole or in part, for nominal cash consideration with no expiration date. Diluted
net income (loss) per ordinary share is computed by dividing the diluted net income (loss) available to ordinary shareholders by the
weighted average number of ordinary shares, including potential dilutive ordinary shares assuming the dilutive effect as determined using
the treasury stock method.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">For
periods in which the Company has reported net losses, diluted net loss per ordinary share is the same as basic net loss per ordinary
share, since dilutive ordinary shares are not assumed to have been issued if their effect is anti-dilutive. The Company reported a net
loss for each of the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000836" name="us-gaap:ScheduleOfAntidilutiveSecuritiesExcludedFromComputationOfEarningsPerShareTextBlock"><p id="xdx_893_eus-gaap--ScheduleOfAntidilutiveSecuritiesExcludedFromComputationOfEarningsPerShareTextBlock_z3bqPUnRzyu6" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
following potential dilutive securities, presented based on amounts outstanding at the end of each reporting period, have been excluded
from the calculation of diluted net loss per share because including them would have had an anti-dilutive impact:</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000855" name="us-gaap:NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_845_eus-gaap--NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyTextBlock_zirLbFMK9Ztk" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><span id="xdx_86B_znf6azO6FZX2">New
accounting pronouncements</span> </b>&#8211; From time to time, new accounting pronouncements are issued by the FASB and rules are issued by
the SEC that the Company has or will adopt as of a specified date. Unless otherwise noted, management does not believe that any other
recently issued accounting pronouncements issued by the FASB or guidance issued by the SEC had, or is expected to have, a material impact
on the Company&#8217;s present or future consolidated financial statements.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Recently
Issued (Not Yet Adopted) Accounting Standards</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
February 2024, the FASB issued ASU 2024-03, <i>Income Statement Reporting Comprehensive Income&#8212;Expense Disaggregation Disclosures
(Subtopic 220-40)</i>. The objective of ASU 2024-03 is to require entities to provide enhanced disclosures of income statement expenses
through disaggregation of specific expense captions. ASU 2024-03 is effective for public companies starting in annual periods beginning
after December 15, 2026 and in interim periods beginning after December 15, 2027. The Company is currently evaluating ASU 2024-03 and
the impact of the disclosures to its consolidated financial statements.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Recently
Adopted Accounting Standards</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
December 2023, the FASB issued ASU 2023-09, <i>Income Taxes (Topic 740): Improvements to Income Tax Disclosures</i>. The objective of
ASU 2023-09 is to enhance disclosures related to income taxes, including specific thresholds for inclusion within the tabular disclosure
of income tax rate reconciliation and specified information about income taxes paid, net of refunds received, disaggregated by federal, state, and foreign jurisdictions. ASU 2023-09 is effective for public companies starting
in annual periods beginning after December 15, 2024. The amendments have been applied on a prospective basis. Refer to Note 12, Income Taxes, for additional details.</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><p id="xdx_85E_ztLZMXGb2fQc" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000857" name="AKTX:PeakBioAcquisitionDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_807_ecustom--PeakBioAcquisitionDisclosureTextBlock_zcUj1NxXcHuc" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Note
3. <span id="xdx_823_zPaFUTPpOkb6">Peak Bio Acquisition</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
connection with the <span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionEffectiveDateOfAcquisition1_c20241114__20241114__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--PeakBioMember_z7TfMtHOQWVa" title="Date of acquisition"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-11-142024-11-14_custom_PeakBioMember" format="ixt:datemonthdayyearen" id="Fact000859" name="us-gaap:BusinessAcquisitionEffectiveDateOfAcquisition1">November 14, 2024</ix:nonNumeric></span> acquisition of Peak Bio, the Company issued a total of <span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues_pid_c20241114__20241114__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__custom--OrdinarySharesMember__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--AmericanDepositarySharesMember_zxThAkFCjJr3" title="Issuance of shares"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues" contextRef="From2024-11-142024-11-14_custom_OrdinarySharesMember_custom_AmericanDepositarySharesMember" id="Fact000861" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">12,613,942</ix:nonFraction></span> Akari ADSs which reflected the
conversion of each issued and outstanding share of Peak Bio Common Stock into the right to receive Akari ADSs representing a number of
Akari Ordinary Shares equal to <span id="xdx_904_ecustom--MergerAgreementExchangeRatioPerOrdinaryShare_iI_pid_c20241114__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__custom--OrdinarySharesMember_zPbyIubTq1Y6" title="Merger agreement exchange ratio per ordinary share"><ix:nonFraction name="AKTX:MergerAgreementExchangeRatioPerOrdinaryShare" contextRef="AsOf2024-11-14_custom_OrdinarySharesMember" id="Fact000863" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Pure">0.2935</ix:nonFraction></span> (the &#8220;Exchange Ratio&#8221;). The Exchange Ratio was calculated in accordance with the terms
of the Merger Agreement and is such that the total number of shares of Akari ADSs issued in connection with the acquisition is approximately
<span id="xdx_90B_ecustom--MergerAgreementExpectedOwnershipInCompanyCounterpartyStockholdersPercentage_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20241114__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--AmericanDepositarySharesMember_zHbUFLKlDKpl" title="Percentage of expected ownership in outstanding shares"><ix:nonFraction name="AKTX:MergerAgreementExpectedOwnershipInCompanyCounterpartyStockholdersPercentage" contextRef="AsOf2024-11-14_custom_AmericanDepositarySharesMember" id="Fact000865" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">48.4</ix:nonFraction></span>% of the outstanding shares of Akari on a fully diluted basis.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">At
the Closing, each Peak Warrant and Peak Option was converted into an Adjusted Warrant and Adjusted Option to purchase a number of Akari
Ordinary Shares or Akari ADSs, based on the Exchange Ratio. The Adjusted Warrants and the Adjusted Options have substantially similar
terms and conditions as were applicable to such Peak Warrants and Peak Options immediately prior to the Closing.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
fair value of the <span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues_pid_c20241114__20241114__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--PeakBioMember__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--AmericanDepositarySharesMember_z2dmDKisypwa" title="Fair value of shares issued"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues" contextRef="From2024-11-142024-11-14_custom_PeakBioMember_custom_AmericanDepositarySharesMember" id="Fact000885" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">12,613,942</ix:nonFraction></span> ADS issued in connection with the acquisition is based on the closing price of the Company&#8217;s ADSs
on the Closing Date multiplied by the number of ADSs issued.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
connection with the acquisition of Peak Bio, the Company assumed (i) warrants issued to investors (&#8220;November 2022 Peak Bio Warrants&#8221;)
to purchase an aggregate of <span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues_pid_c20241114__20241114__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--PeakBioMember__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--AmericanDepositarySharesMember__us-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightAxis__custom--NovemberTwoThousandTwentyTwoPeakBioWarrantsMember_zsD8Og1D8Yv8" title="Purchase of aggregate shares"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues" contextRef="From2024-11-142024-11-14_custom_PeakBioMember_custom_AmericanDepositarySharesMember_custom_NovemberTwoThousandTwentyTwoPeakBioWarrantsMember" id="Fact000887" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">1,577,556</ix:nonFraction></span> ADSs at $<span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--SharesIssuedPricePerShare_iI_pid_c20241114__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--PeakBioMember__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--AmericanDepositarySharesMember__us-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightAxis__custom--NovemberTwoThousandTwentyTwoPeakBioWarrantsMember_z8KQttf9uRad" title="Shares issued price per share"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:SharesIssuedPricePerShare" contextRef="AsOf2024-11-14_custom_PeakBioMember_custom_AmericanDepositarySharesMember_custom_NovemberTwoThousandTwentyTwoPeakBioWarrantsMember" id="Fact000889" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">39.18</ix:nonFraction></span> per ADS, and (ii) warrants issued to investors (&#8220;April 2023 Peak Bio Warrants&#8221;)
to purchase an aggregate of <span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues_pid_c20241114__20241114__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--PeakBioMember__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--AmericanDepositarySharesMember__us-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightAxis__custom--AprilTwoThousandTwentyThreePeakBioWarrantsMember_zo7CW8QwBILc" title="Purchase of aggregate shares"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues" contextRef="From2024-11-142024-11-14_custom_PeakBioMember_custom_AmericanDepositarySharesMember_custom_AprilTwoThousandTwentyThreePeakBioWarrantsMember" id="Fact000891" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">1,187,013</ix:nonFraction></span> ADSs at $<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--SharesIssuedPricePerShare_iI_pid_c20241114__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--PeakBioMember__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--AmericanDepositarySharesMember__us-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightAxis__custom--AprilTwoThousandTwentyThreePeakBioWarrantsMember_zOoKdh18euAl" title="Shares issued price per share"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:SharesIssuedPricePerShare" contextRef="AsOf2024-11-14_custom_PeakBioMember_custom_AmericanDepositarySharesMember_custom_AprilTwoThousandTwentyThreePeakBioWarrantsMember" id="Fact000893" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">2.04</ix:nonFraction></span> per ADS. The assumed Peak Bio warrants are fully vested and thus are included in
the consideration transferred.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company determined that the November 2022 Peak Bio Warrants and the April 2023 Peak Bio Warrants are not indexed to the Company&#8217;s
own stock in the manner contemplated by the relevant accounting guidance. Accordingly, on the Closing of the acquisition, the Company
classified the assumed Peak Bio warrants as derivative liabilities in its consolidated balance sheets.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The

14, 2024:</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Total
Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed </i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
acquisition of Peak Bio has been accounted for as a business combination using the acquisition method of accounting. The fair value of
the purchase price was allocated to the assets acquired and liabilities assumed at their respective fair values. Management estimated
the fair value of the IPR&amp;D intangible assets using a multi-period excess earnings method. The significant assumptions used in the
valuation are the probability of clinical trial success and obtaining regulatory approval, forecasted gross sales from up-front and milestone
payments, royalties and product sales, and the discount rate reflecting the Company&#8217;s weighted average cost of capital. This acquisition
method requires, among other things, that assets acquired, and liabilities assumed in a business combination be recognized at their fair
values as of the acquisition date.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

4. <span id="xdx_82F_zwDknomx1IFc">Intangible Assets</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company&#8217;s IPR&amp;D and goodwill are tested for impairment at least annually, or more frequently if impairment indicators are present.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"></span></p>

<p style="margin: 0; text-align: justify">During the quarter ended September 30, 2025, the Company performed a qualitative assessment and determined that
a change in the Company&#8217;s allocation of resources triggered a quantitative analysis for the Company&#8217;s PHP 303 IPR&amp;D
asset. As a result of the quantitative impairment test, the Company determined that its PHP 303 IPR&amp;D asset was impaired<i>. </i><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
a result, </span>we recorded an impairment charge of $<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--AssetImpairmentCharges_pn4n6_c20250101__20251231_zJcP1CAJD2E7"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:AssetImpairmentCharges" contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" id="Fact001010" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-4" scale="6" unitRef="USD">5.18</ix:nonFraction></span>
million related to the Company&#8217;s PHP 303 asset due to reprioritization of resources to our ADC platform, no further
development plans and inability to find a collaborative partner to date for this program.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.25in; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0">As of December 31, 2025, the Company prepared a quantitative assessment
of its AKTX 101 IPR&amp;D asset and determined there was no impairment of this asset.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The

Lion&#8221;). Pursuant to the ELOC Purchase Agreement, the Company had the right, but not the obligation, to require White Lion to purchase,
from time to time, up to $<span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStock_c20250829__20250829__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--ELOCPurchaseAgreementMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--WhiteLionCapitalLLCMember_zWMrtmv2ZSi1" title="Gross proceeds from issuance of ordinary shares"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStock" contextRef="From2025-08-292025-08-29_custom_ELOCPurchaseAgreementMember_custom_WhiteLionCapitalLLCMember" id="Fact001214" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">25,000,000</ix:nonFraction></span> in aggregate gross purchase price of newly issued Ordinary Shares, which may be exchanged for ADSs,

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The

to the Purchaser. Actual sales of Ordinary Shares to the Purchaser under the ELOC Purchase Agreement will depend on a variety of factors

made by the Company as to appropriate levels and sources of funding.</span></p>

and issued in a private placement an aggregate of <span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues_pid_c20240301__20240331__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__custom--OrdinarySharesMember__us-gaap--SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis__us-gaap--PrivatePlacementMember_zpOTwLywHUOj" title="Issuance of share capital"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues" contextRef="From2024-03-012024-03-31_custom_OrdinarySharesMember_us-gaap_PrivatePlacementMember" id="Fact001440" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">2,641,228,000</ix:nonFraction></span> ordinary shares (<span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights_iI_pid_c20240331__us-gaap--SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis__us-gaap--PrivatePlacementMember__us-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightAxis__dei--AdrMember_zLBHfopGkoRj" title="Number of warrants to purchase shares"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights" contextRef="AsOf2024-03-31_us-gaap_PrivatePlacementMember_dei_AdrMember" id="Fact001442" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">1,320,614</ix:nonFraction></span> ADSs) at $<span id="xdx_909_ecustom--StockIssuedDuringPeriodIssuePricePerShareNewIssues_pid_c20240301__20240331__us-gaap--SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis__us-gaap--PrivatePlacementMember__us-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightAxis__dei--AdrMember_zAwmyfCOZbV5" title="Price per share"><ix:nonFraction name="AKTX:StockIssuedDuringPeriodIssuePricePerShareNewIssues" contextRef="From2024-03-012024-03-31_us-gaap_PrivatePlacementMember_dei_AdrMember" id="Fact001444" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">1.48</ix:nonFraction></span> per ADS, for aggregate gross
proceeds of approximately $<span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPrivatePlacement_pn5n6_c20240301__20240331__us-gaap--SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis__us-gaap--PrivatePlacementMember__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__dei--AdrMember_zM8dWsZQ14nk" title="Aggregate gross proceeds"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPrivatePlacement" contextRef="From2024-03-012024-03-31_us-gaap_PrivatePlacementMember_dei_AdrMember5236390" id="Fact001446" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">2.0</ix:nonFraction></span> million (the &#8220;March 2024 Private Placement&#8221;). Net proceeds from the March 2024 Private Placement
were approximately $<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStock_pn5n6_c20240301__20240331__us-gaap--SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis__us-gaap--PrivatePlacementMember__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__dei--AdrMember_zxIjFyia2BW8" title="Net proceeds"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStock" contextRef="From2024-03-012024-03-31_us-gaap_PrivatePlacementMember_dei_AdrMember5236390" id="Fact001448" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">1.7</ix:nonFraction></span> million after deducting placement agent fees and other expenses.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">At
close of the March 2024 Private Placement, the Company issued to Paulson, as placement agent for the March 2024 Private Placement, warrants
to purchase <span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights_iI_pid_c20240331__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__dei--AdrMember__us-gaap--SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis__us-gaap--PrivatePlacementMember_zP18JRqGMPpd" title="Number of warrants to purchase shares"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightNumberOfSecuritiesCalledByWarrantsOrRights" contextRef="AsOf2024-03-31_dei_AdrMember_us-gaap_PrivatePlacementMember" id="Fact001450" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">132,061</ix:nonFraction></span> ADSs at an exercise price of $<span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1_iI_pid_c20240331__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__dei--AdrMember__us-gaap--SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis__us-gaap--PrivatePlacementMember_zU0n4PvdzOk1" title="Exercise price of warrants"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1" contextRef="AsOf2024-03-31_dei_AdrMember_us-gaap_PrivatePlacementMember" id="Fact001452" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">1.85</ix:nonFraction></span> per ADS (representing <span id="xdx_90E_ecustom--PercentageOfExercisePriceOfAdsForExercisePriceOfWarrant_pid_dp_uPure_c20240301__20240331__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__dei--AdrMember__us-gaap--SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis__us-gaap--PrivatePlacementMember_zhxgFPbepvr6" title="Exercise price per share rate"><ix:nonFraction name="AKTX:PercentageOfExercisePriceOfAdsForExercisePriceOfWarrant" contextRef="From2024-03-012024-03-31_us-gaap_PrivatePlacementMember_dei_AdrMember5236390" id="Fact001454" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">125</ix:nonFraction></span>% of the purchase price per ADS sold in the March 2024
Private Placement) and a term expiring on March 27, 2029 (the &#8220;March 2024 Placement Agent Warrants&#8221;). The estimated fair
value of the March 2024 Placement Agent Warrants on the issuance date was approximately $<span id="xdx_90B_ecustom--EstimatedFairValueOfPlacementAgentWarrants_pn5n6_c20240301__20240331__us-gaap--SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis__us-gaap--PrivatePlacementMember__us-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightAxis__custom--PlacementAgentWarrantsMember_zBTvHqDDmJd3" title="Percentage of exercise price per share"><ix:nonFraction name="AKTX:EstimatedFairValueOfPlacementAgentWarrants" contextRef="From2024-03-012024-03-31_us-gaap_PrivatePlacementMember_custom_PlacementAgentWarrantsMember" id="Fact001456" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">0.2</ix:nonFraction></span> million.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company determined that the March 2024 Placement Agent Warrants met all of the criteria for equity classification. Accordingly, upon
closing of the March 2024 Private Placement, each of the March 2024 Placement Agent Warrants was recorded as a component of additional
paid-in capital.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Warrants</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>&#160;</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
connection with various financing transactions, the Company has issued warrants to purchase the Company&#8217;s ordinary shares represented
by ADSs. The Company accounts for such warrants as equity instruments or liabilities, depending on the specific terms of the warrant
agreement. See Note 2 for further details on the accounting policy related to the Company&#8217;s warrants.</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact001680" name="us-gaap:DisclosureOfCompensationRelatedCostsShareBasedPaymentsTextBlock"><p id="xdx_801_eus-gaap--DisclosureOfCompensationRelatedCostsShareBasedPaymentsTextBlock_z36dlXL9EPt2" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Note
8. <span id="xdx_823_zQpBKkGW4IWe">Stock-Based Compensation</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>&#160;</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>2023
Equity Incentive Plan</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
June 30, 2023, the Company&#8217;s shareholders approved the 2023 Equity Incentive Plan (the &#8220;2023 Plan&#8221;), which provides
for the grant of stock options, both incentive stock options and nonqualified stock options, stock, with and without vesting restrictions,
restricted stock units (&#8220;RSUs&#8221;) and stock appreciation rights, to be granted to employees, directors and consultants.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
June 30, 2025, the Company&#8217;s shareholders approved an increase in the number of ordinary shares available for the grant of
awards under the 2023 Plan by <span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfAdditionalSharesAuthorized_pid_c20250630__20250630__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--EquityIncentivePlanTwentyTwentyThreeMember_z2uf9w3RDpsj" title="Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Number of Additional Shares Authorized"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfAdditionalSharesAuthorized" contextRef="From2025-06-302025-06-30_custom_EquityIncentivePlanTwentyTwentyThreeMember" id="Fact001682" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">11,026,000,000</ix:nonFraction></span>
to an aggregate of <span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAvailableForGrant_iI_pid_c20250630__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--EquityIncentivePlanTwentyTwentyThreeMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_zXpdFvJFNMFg" title="Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Number of Additional Shares Authorized"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAvailableForGrant" contextRef="AsOf2025-06-30_custom_EquityIncentivePlanTwentyTwentyThreeMember_srt_MaximumMember" id="Fact001684" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">19,174,713,522</ix:nonFraction></span>
Ordinary Shares, inclusive of awards granted under the previously approved 2014 Equity Incentive Plan (&#8220;2014 Plan&#8221;) that
may be forfeited, cancelled, or expire unexercised.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
of December 31, 2025, <span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAvailableForGrant_iI_pid_c20251231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--EquityIncentivePlanTwentyTwentyThreeMember_zSo7x4ehpdB3" title="Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Number of Shares Available for Grant"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAvailableForGrant" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_EquityIncentivePlanTwentyTwentyThreeMember" id="Fact001686" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">9,084,764,210</ix:nonFraction></span> ordinary shares were available for future issuance under the 2023 Plan.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
2023 and 2014 Plans provide that they be administered by the compensation committee of the board of directors. The exercise price for
stock option awards may not be less than <span id="xdx_909_ecustom--PercentageOfFairMarketValueOfShares_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--EquityIncentivePlanTwentyTwentyThreeAndFourteenMember_z0Yq047W7Tr" title="Percentage of fair market value of shares"><ix:nonFraction name="AKTX:PercentageOfFairMarketValueOfShares" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_EquityIncentivePlanTwentyTwentyThreeAndFourteenMember" id="Fact001688" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">100</ix:nonFraction></span>% of the fair market value of the Company&#8217;s ordinary shares on the date of grant and
the term of awards may not be greater than <span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardExpirationPeriod_dc_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--EquityIncentivePlanTwentyTwentyThreeAndFourteenMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_zZ9EQGSxXBf5" title="Term of awards"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_EquityIncentivePlanTwentyTwentyThreeAndFourteenMember_srt_MaximumMember" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen" id="Fact001690" name="us-gaap:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardExpirationPeriod">ten years</ix:nonNumeric></span>. The Company determines the fair value of its ordinary shares based on the quoted
market price of its ADSs. Vesting periods are determined at the discretion of the compensation committee.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>&#160;</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>2014
Equity Incentive Plan</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Under
the 2014 Plan, the Company was authorized to grant stock options, restricted stock units and other awards, to employees, members of the
board of directors and consultants. Upon effectiveness of the 2023 Plan, no further awards are available to be issued under the 2014
Plan.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>&#160;</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Peak
Bio Long Term Incentive Plan</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
November 14, 2024, the Company assumed the Peak Bio Long Term Incentive Plan. Upon closing of the acquisition, no further awards are
available to be issued under the Peak Bio Long Term Incentive Plan. Any awards, forfeited, expired or cancelled shall not increase the
number of ordinary shares available for the grant of awards under the 2023 Plan. As of December 31, 2025, the Company had stock options
to purchase up to <span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAvailableForGrant_iI_pid_c20251231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--EquityIncentivePlanTwentyThousandFourteenMember_zIOT3yaqPBPl" title="Stock options purchased"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAvailableForGrant" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_EquityIncentivePlanTwentyThousandFourteenMember" id="Fact001692" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">3,003,024,000</ix:nonFraction></span> ordinary shares under the Peak Bio Long Term Incentive Plan.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
aggregate intrinsic value of options is calculated as the difference between the exercise price of the options and the fair value of
the Company&#8217;s ADSs for those options that had exercise prices lower than the fair value of the Company&#8217;s ordinary shares.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Performance-Based
Stock Options</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
of December 31, 2025, the Company had performance-based stock options (&#8220;PSOs&#8221;) for the purchase of an aggregate of <span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsGrantsInPeriod_pid_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--AwardTypeAxis__us-gaap--PerformanceSharesMember_zHjGVsFOxSB" title="Aggregate of shares"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsGrantsInPeriod" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_us-gaap_PerformanceSharesMember" id="Fact001754" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">375,000</ix:nonFraction></span>
ADSs of the Company outstanding, which were granted to consultants. Vesting of PSOs granted to consultants is based upon attainment of
certain research and licensing agreements. All PSOs are subject to continuous service by the executives. The probability of vesting is
reviewed each reporting period and management has concluded that the PSOs have not vested until the performance conditions have been
satisfied. Therefore, the PSOs remain unvested and outstanding as of December 31, 2025. The Company has not recognized stock-based compensation
expense associated with these performance awards during the year ended December 31, 2025. As of December 31, 2025, total unrecognized
compensation cost related to these performance-based stock options awards was $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationNonvestedAwardsTotalCompensationCostNotYetRecognized_iI_pn5n6_c20251231__us-gaap--AwardTypeAxis__us-gaap--PerformanceSharesMember_zKuVhALoGN3c" title="Unrecognized compensation cost"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationNonvestedAwardsTotalCompensationCostNotYetRecognized" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_us-gaap_PerformanceSharesMember" id="Fact001756" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">0.3</ix:nonFraction></span> million, which will be recognized if the awards are
deemed to be probable of vesting.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Restricted
Stock Units</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
2023 Plan provides for the award of restricted stock units (&#8220;RSUs&#8221;). RSUs are granted to employees that are subject to
time-based vesting conditions that lapse between one <span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingPeriod1_dtY_c20250101__20251231__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember__us-gaap--AwardTypeAxis__us-gaap--RestrictedStockUnitsRSUMember__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--EquityIncentivePlan2014Member_zmZfbjgmxNE" title="Vesting period (in years)" style="display: none"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_srt_MinimumMember_us-gaap_RestrictedStockUnitsRSUMember_custom_EquityIncentivePlan2014Member" format="ixt-sec:duryear" id="Fact001758" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingPeriod1">1</ix:nonNumeric></span> year and <span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingPeriod1_dc_c20250101__20251231__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember__us-gaap--AwardTypeAxis__us-gaap--RestrictedStockUnitsRSUMember__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--EquityIncentivePlan2014Member_zvR3wjTK0UV3" title="Vesting period (in years)"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_srt_MaximumMember_us-gaap_RestrictedStockUnitsRSUMember_custom_EquityIncentivePlan2014Member" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen" id="Fact001760" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingPeriod1">four years</ix:nonNumeric></span> from date of grant, assuming continued employment.
Compensation cost for time-based RSUs, which vest only on continued service, is recognized on a straight-line basis over the
requisite service period based on the grant date fair of the RSU&#8217;s, which is derived from the closing price of the
Company&#8217;s ADS&#8217;s on the date of grant.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Interim
CEO Agreement</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
May 31, 2024, the Company and Dr. Samir Patel entered into an Interim Chief Executive Officer Agreement, effective as of May 1, 2024
(the &#8220;Interim CEO Agreement&#8221;). Pursuant to the Interim CEO Agreement, Dr. Patel served as the Company&#8217;s Interim President
and Chief Executive Officer as an independent contractor on an at-will basis. The Interim CEO Agreement could be terminated by the Company
immediately for any reason. As the sole compensation for services provided under the Interim CEO Agreement, Dr. Patel was paid $<span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionAmountsOfTransaction_c20240531__20240531__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionAxis__custom--InterimCeoAgreementMember_zdfvI7Wri6zi" title="Payment to CEO upon aggrement"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:RelatedPartyTransactionAmountsOfTransaction" contextRef="From2024-05-312024-05-31_custom_InterimCeoAgreementMember" id="Fact001920" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">50,000</ix:nonFraction></span>
per month in the form of fully vested Ordinary Shares. On September 16, 2024, the Company entered into an amendment to the Interim CEO
Agreement (the &#8220;CEO Amendment Agreement&#8221;), effective July 1, 2024, to revise Dr. Patel&#8217;s compensation in connection
with the services as Interim President and Chief Executive Officer. Pursuant to the CEO Amendment Agreement, in lieu of receiving the
stated monthly compensation of $<span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionAmountsOfTransaction_c20240916__20240916__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionAxis__custom--InterimCeoAgreementMember_z3sSkc7nJQwg" title="Payment to CEO upon aggrement"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:RelatedPartyTransactionAmountsOfTransaction" contextRef="From2024-09-162024-09-16_custom_InterimCeoAgreementMember" id="Fact001922" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">50,000</ix:nonFraction></span> in the form of fully vested Ordinary Shares, <span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionTermsAndMannerOfSettlement_c20240916__20240916__us-gaap--RelatedPartyTransactionAxis__custom--AmendmentInterimCEOAgreementMember_zy7cmS2YERIh" title="Payment terms to CEO upon aggrement"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-09-162024-09-16_custom_AmendmentInterimCEOAgreementMember" id="Fact001924" name="us-gaap:RelatedPartyTransactionTermsAndMannerOfSettlement">Dr. Patel is paid in the form of fully vested non-qualified
stock options to purchase Ordinary Shares (&#8220;NQSO&#8221;), with the number of ADSs underlying each such monthly NQSOs grant to be
equal to two times the number determined by dividing (i) $50,000 by (ii) the closing price of the Company&#8217;s ADSs on the Nasdaq
Capital Market on the last day of each month (or partial month)</ix:nonNumeric></span> Dr. Patel has served as the Company&#8217;s Interim President and Chief
Executive Officer.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
December 12, 2024, the Company&#8217;s board of directors approved the appointment of Dr. Samir Patel to President and Chief Executive
Officer, effective December 16, 2024. There were no changes to Dr. Patel&#8217;s revised compensation under the CEO Amendment Agreement
described above, following Dr. Patel&#8217;s appointment as President and Chief Executive Officer on December 16, 2024. On April 21,
2025, Dr. Patel stepped down as President and Chief Executive Officer.</span></p>

Company&#8217;s Level 3 liabilities consist of the September 2022 Warrants, the November 2022 Peak Bio Warrants and the April 2023 Peak
Bio Warrants, which were determined to be liability-classified instruments, and a derivative liability related to the ELOC Purchase Agreement
(described in Note 7). There were no transfers between Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 during the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024.</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><p id="xdx_8AD_zBSh0LJ1Tb8b" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>&#160;</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Liability-Classified
Warrants</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
fair value of the warrant liabilities is based on significant inputs not observable in the market, which represents a Level 3 measurement
within the fair value hierarchy. The fair value of the September 2022 Series A Warrants, the September 2022 Series B Warrants, the November
2022 Peak Bio Warrants and the April 2023 Bio Peak Warrants was determined using the Black-Scholes Option Pricing Model, which uses various
assumptions, including (i) fair value of the Company&#8217;s ADSs, (ii) exercise price of the warrant, (iii) expected term of the warrant,
(iv) expected volatility and (v) expected risk-free interest rate.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

are the assumptions used for the fair value calculations of liability classified warrants as of December 31, 2025 and 2024:</span></p>
